changes.evidence: Zemo commanded EKO Scorpion before Civil War (F.R.I.D.A.Y.: 'Zemo ran EKO Scorpion'); by Civil War he is a lone avenger after Sokovia, and the wiki lists EKO Scorpion and the Sokovian Armed Forces as former. No group in Civil War or The Falcon and the Winter Soldier.

His Navy SEAL / JSOC ghost-unit service is backstory, told by Everett Ross; by the museum robbery (Eyes of Wakanda / Black Panther) he is working with Klaue, not the U.S. military. Wiki lists U.S. Navy as former.

Kaecilius broke with the Ancient One and formed the Zealots before Doctor Strange begins; the film opens with the Zealots stealing the Book of Cagliostro rites from Kamar-Taj. Masters of the Mystic Arts is former, backstory only.
Ava's S.H.I.E.L.D. service ended when S.H.I.E.L.D. collapsed in 2014, before Ant-Man and the Wasp (2018), where she tells it as backstory; in that film she acts with Bill Foster only.
Foster's S.H.I.E.L.D. work (Project G.O.L.I.A.T.H.) is decades-old backstory; in Ant-Man and the Wasp he is a UC Berkeley professor (wiki: S.H.I.E.L.D. former, UC Berkeley current).

Loki S1 episode 5: President Loki leads his own army of Loki variants (the Loki Bandits) in the Void; after he double-crosses Boastful Loki, his own army turns on him and the group breaks up (wiki: affiliation Loki Bandits (formerly), group defunct).

owner_calls.question: Should Sylvie's McDonald's stage end in Loki S2?
owner_calls.evidence: Loki S2 episode 6: after Loki takes the Loom's place, Sylvie leaves the TVA 'to be on her own' and tells Mobius she has no idea where she is going. The wiki still lists McDonald's (Earth-3311987) as a current affiliation, so this is unsure.
